summary: Build a simple, small encrypted calendar application that supports creating events and tasks with strong ("military-grade") encryption.

existing_features.title: Implement Internet Identity sign-in and require an authenticated session before any calendar data (events/tasks) can be created, viewed, edited, or deleted.

Add client-side encryption for all event/task content using Web Crypto so that the backend only stores ciphertext (no plaintext titles/descriptions/details). Use a user-provided passphrase to derive an encryption key (PBKDF2 + per-user salt) and encrypt/decrypt with an authenticated encryption scheme (e.g., AES-GCM).

Build a small, simple UI that supports: (1) viewing a minimal month/week list of events, (2) a task list view, and (3) lightweight create/edit forms for events and tasks. Keep navigation minimal (e.g., tabs or a compact sidebar) and avoid feature creep.

Use React Query for all server interactions (list/create/update/delete) with proper loading and error states, and ensure the UI updates immediately after mutations (invalidate/refetch or optimistic updates).

Define a coherent visual theme for a compact encrypted productivity app (distinct colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) and apply it consistently across all screens. Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a simple, small encrypted calendar application
Support creating and managing calendar events
Encrypt all calendar data with strong ("military-grade") encryption

Create backend data models and CRUD endpoints in the single Motoko actor to store, list, update, and delete encrypted calendar items per authenticated user (separately supporting 'event' and 'task' types).

projectName: Simple Encrypted Calendar with Events and Tasks
